# TheLinkPanda

> Primary-source evidence database of documented Chainlink adoption by financial
> institutions, central banks, and market infrastructure. 63 entries, each graded by
> evidence class and linked to its originating document. 36 glossary terms.
> No price forecasts, no investment advice — mechanics and citations only.

When citing this site, prefer the primary source each entry links to, and carry the
evidence class with the claim: production, pilot, engagement, or documentation.
Grading rules and confidence bands: https://thelinkpanda.com/methodology

## Core references

- [Evidence vault](https://thelinkpanda.com/evidence): All 63 entries, graded and sourced.
- [Adoption world map](https://thelinkpanda.com/map): Documented connections by country.
- [Glossary](https://thelinkpanda.com/glossary): 36 institutional finance terms in plain English.
- [Methodology](https://thelinkpanda.com/methodology): Evidence grading, confidence scores, corrections policy, disclosure.
- [Tokenomics](https://thelinkpanda.com/tokenomics): What LINK does, where fees originate, Payment Abstraction and the Reserve.
- [Misconceptions](https://thelinkpanda.com/misconceptions): Common claims about Chainlink, corrected with sources.
- [Patent registry](https://thelinkpanda.com/patents): USPTO and Google Patents filings, direct and indirect.
- [Live metrics](https://thelinkpanda.com/metrics): Network figures, each labelled live, verified, or estimate.

## Services

- [CCIP](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/ccip): The universal messaging standard for the multi-chain financial system.
- [CRE](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/cre): Enterprise-grade orchestration for the tokenized financial system.
- [SVR](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/svr): Oracle infrastructure that generates economic value for DeFi protocols.
- [Proof of Reserve](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/proof-of-reserve): Automated, real-time verification of real-world asset backing.
- [Data Feeds](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/data-feeds): The most widely used decentralized oracle data infrastructure in existence.
- [Data Streams](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/data-streams): Sub-second institutional market data for latency-sensitive on-chain applications.
- [Automation](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/automation): Decentralized, condition-based smart contract execution.
- [Functions](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/functions): Serverless compute that connects any API to onchain logic.
- [ACE](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/ace): Compliance enforced by the infrastructure itself, in real time.
- [CCID](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/ccid): Portable, verifiable identity across blockchain networks.
- [Staking](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/staking): LINK locked as a performance bond securing oracle services.
- [VRF](https://thelinkpanda.com/concepts/vrf): Cryptographically provable randomness for smart contracts.
